image_description: A close-up view of a large whale breaching or surfacing in dark ocean water. The whale has a dark grey, mottled skin with white patches (barnacles/callosities) on its head and rostrum. A bright orange object, resembling a buoy or marker, is attached to or resting on the whale's back near the blowhole area. Water splashes around the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rostrum appears elongated and pointed rather than short and arched. The blowholes are obscured by the orange object and splash, making verification impossible, but the visible head shape deviates from the 'short' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture clearly shows mottling and distinct white patches consistent with barnacle encrustation typical of grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image frame cuts off before the posterior back where dorsal knuckles would be located. Only the anterior/mid-section is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body exhibits the robust, thick girth characteristic of a large baleen whale.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed; baleen plates are internal and not visible in this external shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are not visible in the current framing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail flukes are outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The white patches on the head exhibit the raised, rough texture associated with callosities/barnacles.

artifact_observations.reasoning: An unnatural, bright orange geometric object (resembling a plastic buoy or toy) is fused with or resting on the whale. While physically possible as debris, its perfect geometry and saturation contrast sharply with the organic subject, suggesting potential AI hallucination or an unusual composite element.
Slight smudging in the splash dynamics around the orange object, lacking the crisp droplet definition expected in high-speed photography.
